source_manifest.access_note: Original SF result archive inaccessible (HTTP 403 / TLS failure) during import. Ballot patterns and the official-round transcription are pinned from DataDiver; precinct rounds are reconstructed, not certified native precinct round reports.
source_manifest.attribution: DataDiver by Jesse Garnier (SF State Journalism), https://datadiver.jlabsf.org, CC BY 4.0. Source data: San Francisco Department of Elections. See retained LICENSE-CONTENT.md.

caveat: Precinct round counts are independently replayed from DataDiver’s compact public CVR archive and reconcile to its transcription of the published official round table. They are not official precinct round reports. Three CVR records without precinct location remain in a separate citywide ledger. CVR record totals differ from all-election ballots cast; continuing votes are not turnout.
